# Maintained straight-annulus reference fixtures

These five independently derived reference files are byte-identical to their qualified originals in physics checkpoint `af4120ba52b46922da8bae5a876033e53818adfa`. They cover source OD/effective-wall geometry and bounded near-incompressible fixed/free/two-span/rotation controls. The JSON contains the original expectations and provenance; no values or tolerances changed.

The maintained public test loads these local fixtures so production regression tests do not depend on a dated agent-run directory. Historical derivations and independent reviews remain at their original paths in that checkpoint. This relocation is not new physical qualification, full method closure or a change to the analytical1e-9 criterion.
